description: This file contains unit tests for the LayoutTestRunner and Sharder classes used in WebKit layout tests, including test cases for test sharding, failure handling, and lock checking.

classes.name: FakePrinter
classes.description: A mock printer class for testing, with stub methods for printing test results and updates.

classes.name: LockCheckingRunner
classes.description: A subclass of LayoutTestRunner that checks lock handling during test runs.

classes.name: LayoutTestRunnerTests
classes.description: Test suite for LayoutTestRunner, including failure limits and summary updates.

classes.name: SharderTests
classes.description: Test suite for the Sharder class, verifying test sharding logic.

methods.name: _runner
methods.description: Creates a LockCheckingRunner instance with default options for testing.

methods.name: _run_tests
methods.description: Runs a set of tests using the provided runner.

methods.name: test_interrupt_if_at_failure_limits
methods.description: Tests that the runner correctly interrupts at failure or crash limits.

methods.name: test_update_summary_with_result
methods.description: Tests the update of test run summaries based on individual test results.

methods.name: get_test_input
methods.description: Creates a TestInput object for a given test file, indicating if it requires a lock.

methods.name: get_shards
methods.description: Generates test shards based on the current configuration and test list.

methods.name: assert_shards
methods.description: Asserts that the actual test shards match expected shard names and test lists.

methods.name: test_shard_by_dir
methods.description: Verifies correct sharding of tests by directory.

methods.name: test_shard_every_file
methods.description: Verifies sharding when each test is isolated.

methods.name: test_shard_in_two
methods.description: Verifies sharding splits tests into two groups.

methods.name: test_shard_in_two_has_no_locked_shards
methods.description: Verifies sharding with no locked shards when only one test is provided.

methods.name: test_shard_in_two_has_no_unlocked_shards
methods.description: Verifies sharding with only locked shards when only one test is provided.

methods.name: test_multiple_locked_shards
methods.description: Verifies multiple locked shards are created correctly.

methods.name: test_virtual_shards
methods.description: Verifies virtual test sharding behavior with different run modes.
